title: THE ROLE OF COMPUTER LINGUISTICS IN UZBEKISTAN LINGUISTICS
description: Since the middle of the 20th century, the process of globalization has begun, which has fundamentally changed the history of mankind. cannot satisfy the needs of the youth. The important features of global development are determined by the introduction of technology into the spheres, the formation of computer programs, and the integration process. In the current global integration process, the creation of an information method based on natural language has become a vital necessity. Today, one of the important needs is to raise the status of the Uzbek language and bring it to the ranks of authoritative languages. Computational linguistics is one of the convenient opportunities created to implement this need. This article is aimed at highlighting the topic indicated above.
